title: Change Party Member during the fight without plugin, i wanna make manually.

posts.author: Skull150
posts.body:
Hello, I’m currently working on a system where players can swap their SV sprites, similar to the style of Pokémon. I know about the Yangly plugin, but unfortunately, I can't afford it at the moment. I found md file of the plugin in GitHub but i don't know is safe to use. Here are a few ideas I have in mind:
Instead of showing the game over screen when a character's HP reaches zero, allow the player to switch to another character with full HP.
Allow the player to freely choose which character they want to use in each turn of battle.
SV actor change for another actor as skill for example: Actor Harold use skill -> Change for Therese Actor -> Therese ATK, Heal or whatever -> Turn Back to Harold Actor
Note:
I would like to know how the bullet count is tracked for characters.

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Welcome to the forums good sir or madam!
So first, what do you mean by MD file of the plugin? If your refer to the paid one then I would recommend not discussing methods of getting paid for plugins.
also, are you requesting help in how to achieve this in battle? Then you'll need someone to make a plugin for you in JS request or help finding a similar plugin.
IF this is possible in the maker through events is something I think is possible but you really got to do a LOT of event working in the battle and maybe for each troops too.  But a Plugin would make this so much easier to do.
As for the note, what do you mean by bullet count?

The MD file is Markdown documentation found on GitHub. I downloaded it, and initially, I thought I could convert it to JavaScript (JS), but I wasn’t successful. Therefore, I decided not to risk it.
Regarding the bullet count, I apologize for not being more specific. What I meant is that my idea is to create an RPG with shooter elements in a first-person view. In this system, the "SV Actor" actually refers to the sprite of the weapon. The bullet count system comes into play next, where each weapon has a specific bullet capacity (e.g., 15 bullets, 20 bullets, etc.). The idea is for the player to switch between weapons during combat, similar to the mechanic in Pokémon.
Sorry for any confusion!

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Ah I see, so the actors act as weapons then?
I think you might be over complicating it there by switching actors in and out.
So to store Bullet count, or Ammo, you could use Variables to store the count of the bullets.
As for the change of graphic, there is a event that will change how the SV graphic will look so can use that for changing weapons.
As for the Ammo cost, you can use a Plugin that allows you to set the cost for each skill or action that requires ammo orrr if you want to do it via events I think it's possible but is your combat set up in turn based or real time shooting?
